title_sq: Shitet Njesi tregtare prane Shkolles se baletit
description_sq:
Shitet Njesi tregtare prane Shkolles se baletit
Shitet Njesi tregtare me siperfaqe totale 996 m2,e ndare ne dy kate nga 498 m2 secili.
Ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te urbanizuara te Tiranes,midis Shkolles se baletit dhe Tregut elektrik,
Pozicionimi i prones prane rruges kryesore "Petronini Luarasi",krijon mundesine qe prona te shfytezohet per te gjitha llojet e bizneseve,por nga siperfaqja dhe organizimi do ishte me e pershtatshme per Supermarket ose Palester.
Sic shihet dhe nga planimetria prona ka formen e salles dhe nuk ka ndarje ne kthina.
Zbritja nga kati perdhe ne katin -1 realizohet me ane te shkalleve te brendshme.
Eshte perdorur prej vitesh si supermarket,por ka nevoje per investim.
Prona disponon Certifikate pronesie.
Cmimi i shitjes 1500 Euro/m2
Per nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni
title_en: Commercial unit for sale near the ballet school
description_en: Commercial unit for sale near the ballet school. Commercial unit for sale with a total area of ​​996 m2, divided into two floors of 498 m2 each. It is located in one of the most urbanized areas of Tirana, between the Ballet School and the Electric Market. The positioning of the property near the main street "Petronini Luarasi" creates the possibility that the property can be used for all types of businesses, but from the surface and organization it would be more suitable for a Supermarket or Gym. As can be seen from the floor plan, the property has the shape of a hall and there are no partitions in the alcoves. The descent from the ground floor to the -1st floor is carried out by means of internal stairs. It has been used for years as a supermarket, but it needs investment. The property has Ownership Certificates. Selling price 1500 Euro/m2 For a visit to the property, contact us
